author: @AlaskanLost
text: Day one. I awake in the morning. My eyes sting from new beginnings. With my new eyes I reach over and pick up the bowl and lighter. I inhale deeply and as I exhale I say to myself "ffs today is going to suck". I stand up and work my way downstairs. I've got 45 minutes before the kids wake up for school. I feed the cats, give them fresh water. As the coffee pot brews I turn the lights back off and stand in the dark looking out the kitchen window. It's dark. Cold. Foggy. In the distance I can make out a figure. But I can't see detail just the outline of this ghostly figure. A bead of sweat drips down the back of my neck as I snap back to reality. I realize that the figure is no long visible in the mist. I hear a creek on the floor and I'm frozen. Is it behind me? Has my days come to end in this very kitchen I stood so happy before? If I turn what horrors will I see? I steady my nerves and I clench my fists, and turn....

author: @abbyr654
text:
picsmics4, you and i have an eerily similar story. i'm probably your age, and also experienced A LOT of trauma in the last 10 years after college. I lost so many family members, lost most of my friends, dove into drug addiction, was homeless, estranged from my family, hopping jobs... It's hard to keep going when you've lost so much, and all of your best memories are behind you. Yet somehow, you keep moving forward with this video as a kind of North Star to guide you.  It's something all of us can learn from: we are never too old to find enjoyment in the things we love.

You don't need another commenter telling you they're rooting for you - so I'll just tell you that you're truly not alone. It gives a lot of us hope that you continue on your path and come back to the thing that makes you happy. Maybe more of us will start doing the same. Thank you for sharing your life with us and showing the rest of us that it's okay to love what you love.

author: @emrickazor2610
text:
I had to come here after seeing a video about the Picsmics comment string. While I do feel leaving my own comment tarnishes a strange and interesting piece of internet history, I also feel like I wanna leave my mark here and say a few things.

First off, Drazen, you're incredible on the drums. I have been trying since before this video was uploaded to play the drums on RB, and I STILL cannot do it. I don't know why I can't, I am typically really good at keeping my rhythm.

Secondly, Picsmics, You've given such an opportunity to see a person grow. It's strange to say, but you've basically grown up on this video. Back in your earliest comments, I get the feeling of a young kid, or maybe and early teen, naïve and a bit dumb to the idea of leaving a ton of comments on a video, and through the course of the comments, you can see a young kid slowly turn into a teenager/young adult, seeing aspects of life quickly change and learning a harsh reality we all face in our own ways. The struggles of life didn't manage to stop you though. You STILL found the time to come back and relive some passionate memories, and you know? That is what life is all about I think. You didn't let anything hold you back from coming here and staying consistent. For literally 15 years of your life. Judging by the way you typed all those years ago, that is probably over half your life, and that is REALLY impressive. The dedication to this particular video is actually mindblowing. I am glad to see your situation is becoming better for you, and I hope you're not only doing great, but thriving.

I find it quite strange that I actually found myself caring a lot about you as a person after seeing just some random video about you. author: @zack2920
text:
Here I am, on a sleepless night kind of like picsmics4, commenting on this video. 

I have JUST heard your story for the first time today, and had to pay a visit here. I don’t know you, I likely never will, but I’m sitting here overwhelmed by some melancholy, wistful feeling while listening to this video, knowing it was the soundtrack to so many formative moments for you, so many sleepless nights of your own. It’s an avenue for you to connect to those nostalgic, carefree days. It isn’t that for me, but I’m oddly overwhelmed by it. I struggle with empathy at times, and yet I feel it deeply in this moment, for some reason, knowing how often you heard it and how ingrained in your brain it must be.

My life is good right now. At times, it hasn’t been. You and I are probably around the same age, and it’s humbling to consider my own highs and lows since your first comment. I’m thinking of people I’ve lost, new people that are now central to my life, knowing some of them may not be in another 15 years, and knowing people I haven’t met yet will be there, if I am, god willing. 

Looking back on your original comments from so many years ago, I remember talking like that to my friends and to strangers in almost empty comment sections just like this one used to be. That, by itself, has connected me to those memories of my own in a way that I haven’t in so long. It’s a really good feeling. Thank you for that. 

I hope you’re happy, stranger. I hope you’re finding the time to create happiness for yourself. I’m happy for you that, despite your trials, you have endured and overcome to the extent that you have. 

I’m glad the echoes echoed back for you. ❤️

author: @picsmics4
text:
What a ride it's been!   Thank you again everyone for your continued love and encouragement.  

This has been tremendous for me, I come in as often as I can and read every single comment.  I love you all and hope you can share with one another the same kind of support you have so kindly shared with me.

Life's been a little rough recently - sadly I lost my dog in a car accident a couple weeks back and have been pretty down.  This isn't the first pet I had in my life but it is the first one I sent away in my own arms.   I still wake up in the night because I saw my dog in my dream :(

I know the pain will dull over time.  It almost always does to a certain degree, but I also know it will never fully heal.  

But you all have been nothing but loving here.  I thank you for that.

author: @cesarramos9766
text:
Just read the story of this entire video and picmics's comments and I genuinely cried a bit. 

I do relate to him when it comes to vehemently seek comfort when life gives you nothing but adversity and problems, but you still decide not to give up, no matter how tired, desperate and unhopeful you feel. I've been battling against depression since I hit puberty and since then I've had a rough time finding happiness and a taste for life. I've cried, screamed, cursed and vehemently asked for God to end my life because I feel like my life is a whole torture I've been through four suicide attempts and I'm still alive. Thank God I'm finally seeking therapy and have grown up as a person to say I'm better than yesterday. I'm really fighting for myself against my mind and adversity. Those who battle and carry on with life despite the number of obstacles and adversities are the strongest people ever.

author: @kafdu
text: sometimes i feel alone, even when the room filled with people, i feel like I'm a small human in a big place, alone, cold and no one there to talk to, i couldn't even cry, Because my family taught me that crying is a weakness, and as a man you shouldn't cry and show your weakness because others depend on you, and I agree with them on "some depend on me", i can't be weak for those who i love, but man some time i cant but still i don't do anything. but a few months ago when i found this vid, I come from time to time when I feel lost. I sit in the corner of my dark room and read people’s comments and the love they send to picsmics4, and I say to myself, if there are people who do not know this person but give him all this love, then there must be someone, somewhere, who loves me for some reason. And supports me somehow i don't know but i try to imagine that and lie to myself just to keep on cuz man, sometime i feel like i don't want to go on anymore, My life has been difficult since I was born because I was born in a poor country to a poor family, but I do not complain about this because I am accustomed to it, but today I received news that I may not get the thing that I wanted and worked hard for for the last four years of my life. i hope i get it and come back here with My tears of joy، and i hope everyone get what they want in their life, And I really would rather someone like you get what he wants than what I want for myself, best of luck for everyone

"It was echoes into the void, and I think I found some comfort in nothing echoing back, other than the sound of a familiar piece of music. Today, it is as if the fifteen years of echoes all came ringing back at once, and they were more caring, loving, and powerful than anything I'd ever imagined"
So beautifully worded, honestly. Life has its ups and downs, but I believe we all find solace and comfort in something, be it a music video, or a piece of art. Like picmics4, I consistently turn to the tender embrace of the song "All I Want Is You" from time to time. It brings me peace, and a sense of attachment each time I listen, no matter the context or circumstance. I connect with your sentiments, and I believe this connection resonates universally. We all feel deeply attached to something, whether it be a memory, a loved one, or a musical piece. In my case, it's the song that gives me such a profound sense of affinity within me that whenever I am full of heart or pressed for time which prevents me from listening to it, it just plays in my heart's core, and I love it.. I'm so glad to be a part of internet history and partake in it as it goes by.

author: @Katie29Archive
text:
Well, now it's 6 am. Cool. Throughout last two hours I've been listening to ai cover of CG5's "every door" with spongebob and plankton. I don't know, why, but I like it more, than the original. It hits harder.

Honestly, the fact, that ai got so highly developed is absolutely terrifying to me. I'm scared of what the future will bring. For fuck sake, deepfakes are getting much more advanced! Full song covers or speeches, which are more than believable. Presidents playing minecraft. Chatgpt learned to code and write stories! We have endless episodes of seinfeld, spongebob and family guy, fully written by AI! I already heard, that there are works on mind reading ai. Just imagine, how this could be abused. Come to your friendly government for your mandatory mind reading. You've got nothing to hide, right? I'll be honest, I don't want to live to see thought crimes becoming a real thing. I'm scared.

I'm listening to this song, while writing this. It's so beautiful. It's nostalgic. It brings me back to older times. To simpler times. Back when the most advanced ai was cleverbot. Back, when we weren't in a fucking cold war 2. Back when things were much smaller, but seemed much bigger to us. I miss those times.

author: @shoukabir
text: picsmics4, I know the feeling of a certain attraction or attachment to a sense of familiarity all too well. the bittersweet memories of nostalgia, connecting memories together almost like a sort of time capsule. I have a similar form of connection to sounds, scents, textures and even trivial things like air pressure and weather. your comfort to this game and video, resembles my comfort to listening to certain songs and playing a certain video game and going to certain parts of the map at certain times of day. it’s insane how these things get us through tough times. I’m glad your doing better, although I’m still young (about the same age as you when you commented on this, maybe? i’m 18) it gives me all the more reason to appreciate your story and your vulnerability, its not easy to be vulnerable like that even if it’s an obscure video. you kept going with sounds to a void that never echoed back and one day it did, and that my friend is inspiring, i hope you’ve found out the rewards of not giving up. i’m sure if ever you need anything, this community will be here for you. this video is not your only friend.

text: Log Three: Today has been a roller coaster of emotions. First this morning I was finally able to get nicotine and I attended the 2 classes required for the day.  I got some new clothes I ordered from an unclaimed baggage sight, then around dinner time my dad decided to lose his shit and get drunk off his ass (Even after the several heart attacks hes had).He was taking out his anger on my mom because one of our chickens passing away due to a vulture. He then went outside, barley able to stand up due to his excessive drunkeness, with MY Henry .22 and sat out there. My mother messaged him and calmly expressed her concern with the fact he was trying to shoot an endangered bird WHILE drunk af. He then came inside and screamed at her for about an hour until I had had enough and gave my two cents about the situation. He then started bringing up mistakes I made YEARS ago and calling me a worthless peice of shit and that I should have never been born yadayadayda. I called him out in a fit of rage and silenced him. After that ordeal I cleaned my room most of the way and everything was getting better, until I got a text message from my buddy I was SUPPOSED to be hanging out with. He said he couldn't because he'd be attending my other "friend" Landon's birthday thingy. Worst part is, I dont think I even got a damn invite. I never even did anything to him. Anyways that was my third shit day in a row. (Inspired by picsmics4) -Log 4 coming tommorow.

author: @PSiDUCK8888
text: I used to used to host Rock Band parties almost every weekend when I was a teenager. Small things I forgot about like the improvable drum fills, microphone tambourine, bass groove, and unison bonus all fed into that sense of connectedness between players. It makes me want to go back to rock band 3 to learn the pro guitar and piano peripherals with someone. I doubt the servers for these games are still up, but if anyone is down to try and make this happen through an emulator or something, drop a reply and I'll try to set it up! Shout outs to picsmics and drazen. Much love to all of y'all. This video, aside from being genuinely awesome, made me wonder if GH and RB would still be a household name if it weren't for all the Activision cooperate greed that over saturated the plastic instrument market.

author: @luxingtonsluxidity
text:
I just wanted to come here and say

I found this through another YTer - @ShaiiValley - and that was the first YT video to make me cry.  Just reading through everything hit me in a personal place because I relate to this situation on a number of levels.

But also because I've grown so accustomed to seeing these kinds of stories and knowing that the worst case scenario being the typical; It's so easy to assume that either it ends up being a stalker, or the original uploader gets freaked out and cuts connection, or someone finds and makes fun of it and the commenter goes away, with no knowledge as to whether or not they're okay, be it physically or mentally.

I've recently been in a negative place emotionally for various reasons, so seeing something so wholesome and ending with such love and people coming together just to be supportive... I mean this sincerely: I needed this right now.

@picsmics4, thank you for being so open and willing to share.  @DrazenXLive, thank you for staying impartial and leaving this open for the public + sharing the original video as well!!  I used to obsess over this and GH both at one point; Never managed to FC near as much as I wanted to, but I nailed the tier that had "Cult of Personality" in GHIII, so I WAS MAKING MY WAY THERE YO I should take this as inspiration and pick these games back up again real talk.

author: @picsmics4
text:
I'm not sure exactly what is going on and  tbh I am a mess of emotions right now, from absolute confusion to, in a sense,  joy. 

While i understand this is a public video, I never actually expected it to be found, let alone by so many at once.  It would be a lie to say I don't feel a little embarrassed!

Drazen, I apologize if this is bothering you, I hope it isn't.  I didn't mean for any of this to blow up suddenly.

And i cannot speak enough thanks and gratitude for all the warmth everyone has shared with me. These are words I have never heard, and attention I have never had. I haven't cried since I was in high school 15 years ago, not even when my father passed, but today I shed a few tears. 

I want to share that last 10 years have been tough but I am in a much better place now. I have courage in life I did not before, and it has helped me find work, a place to live, and a life of my own for the first time in a long time. Thank you so much for your concerns and for your love. 

I was in high school when I first found this video.   I favorited it to watch it often and practice my rock band drums.   This song ended up being the first and only FC I accomplished on expert drums. 

This video was briefly lost to time as my youtube favorites list grew, and I had less and less time to spend online. But after accidentally rediscovering it and seeing my own young self's silly comment from years ago, i felt a strange sense of bitter nostalgia. A lot of things in life had gone south quickly and that was the moment I realized just how suddenly and quickly I aged. 

I browse YouTube in bed on nights I have trouble sleeping.  Whenever that happened, I'd visit and leave a comment. 

It was echos into the void, and I think I found some comfort in nothing echoing back, other than the sound of a familiar piece of music. 

Today, it is as if the 15 years of echos all came ringing back at once, and they were more caring, loving and powerful than anything I ever imagined. 

I don't know what to say. Thank you. I will return spirit of encouragement and support back to you all multifold larger if I can.  

I travel a lot for my work now so I can't sit and browse often, but I have read every single comment here.  Drazen, thank you specially for this platform. I seriously don't mean to be creepy!  At some point I was like 'what am I doing here' too, while leaving yet another comment.

I will visit whenever I can.

author: @yunumberjuan7388
text:
picsmics.. I just want you to know im right there with you. Im 25, the reality of life and death is tangible, and adult responsibilities can be debilitating. I used to watch channels like Roosterteeth religiously, and now they've all moved on. I miss those days more than I can express. They were like my best friends, maybe like this video was to you. We have much more to worry about now, but there's a lot of life ahead of us. Things change, people change, and circumstances change, but that's life. I hope you are okay and happy. We may never have the innocence of childhood ever again. But there's a whole lot of good we can do for this world. I hope to be as passionate some day as you are about this simple rockband song, because really, that's what its always been about. Don't doubt what's brought you back here after all these years. It's real. I love ya. I hope we can make this rock a better place. Take care, be well. Stay you.

- Josh

author: @sonomirkoprime
text:
i don’t want to invade picsmics4 space but i thought we could all post whatever we are going through just to feel less alone so….
i don’t know man life is rly tough. i’m approaching 29 y.o and i don’t have a job. my last employment rly rly fckd me up. i’m struggling with mental health since i was 16. i struggled all these years and never accomplished anything. as i was saying my last job was so so toxic and i didn’t have di energies to go back to life after it ended. i closed myself so much, struggled with alcoholism and depression but on the edge i found some energies to go to therapy. i started taking meds and i feel more of a person i want to become. with the help of my therapist im trying to do what i alsways wanted to do: make music. i love to write and sing. it gives me so much hope and joy, even though i can’t feel them anymore. 
these holidays broke all my rythm and i’m struggling with anxiety and depression once again… yesterday i wrote a song i find decent, at least.
i rly want to be a singer or at least a writer. i want people to like what im doing and to create a sort of movement that can bring joy and inspire fragile people like me. i hope i can move out from my parents house soon too but in milan (italy) there’s a very bad housing crisis and i don’t have too much hope.
i’m sending this to the “void” because it feels good to just let it out… let it out man, let it out.

Oh also to someone who suggested a gofundme - thank you so much that you would even think of this at all!   I must only accept the sentiment, however, as I am saving enough soon to pick myself up some more up to date systems :)   this will be the first time in my life I can buy something like this for myself, with my own money and will, so I am quite happy as is!

author: @plcsmics4
text:
I'm not sure exactly what is going on and  tbh I am a mess of emotions right now, from absolute confusion to, in a sense,  joy. 

While i understand this is a public video, I never actually expected it to be found, let alone by so many at once.  It would be a lie to say I don't feel a little embarrassed!

Drazen, I apologize if this is bothering you, I hope it isn't.  I didn't mean for any of this to blow up suddenly.

And i cannot speak enough thanks and gratitude for all the warmth everyone has shared with me. These are words I have never heard, and attention I have never had. I haven't cried since I was in high school 15 years ago, not even when my father passed, but today I shed a few tears. 

I want to share that last 10 years have been tough but I am in a much better place now. I have courage in life I did not before, and it has helped me find work, a place to live, and a life of my own for the first time in a long time. Thank you so much for your concerns and for your love. 

I was in high school when I first found this video.   I favorited it to watch it often and practice my rock band drums.   This song ended up being the first and only FC I accomplished on expert drums. 

This video was briefly lost to time as my youtube favorites list grew, and I had less and less time to spend online. But after accidentally rediscovering it and seeing my own young self's silly comment from years ago, i felt a strange sense of bitter nostalgia. A lot of things in life had gone south quickly and that was the moment I realized just how suddenly and quickly I aged. 

I browse YouTube in bed on nights I have trouble sleeping.  Whenever that happened, I'd visit and leave a comment. 

It was echos into the void, and I think I found some comfort in nothing echoing back, other than the sound of a familiar piece of music. 

Today, it is as if the 15 years of echos all came ringing back at once, and they were more caring, loving and powerful than anything I ever imagined. 

I don't know what to say. Thank you. I will return spirit of encouragement and support back to you all multifold larger if I can.  

I travel a lot for my work now so I can't sit and browse often, but I have read every single comment here.  Drazen, thank you specially for this platform. I seriously don't mean to be creepy!  At some point I was like 'what am I doing here' too, while leaving yet another comment.

I will visit whenever I can.

author: @Lowinns
text:
Hey picsmics4. Even though i probably will never know who you are, your history is just absolutely beautiful. You had the effort to come here often for 16 years, and even after that time you still come here. I'd really like to have your dedication, because you're just strong. Mentally and physically. I Hope your life is okay now, and that you didn't have any sad loss. I Hope you could(or can) confess to your partner, and that they lovely accepted(accept) it. Hope you get your own house with her/him (i don't know) soon. Even tho, this is probably the only comment i'll leave here just to support you, i wanna say i appreciate whoever is behind that screen. Hope you could buy your own console, a new TV, and whatever you want in life. Everything you have acomplished or gained, it's because you deserved it. Well deserved. You seem like the perfect person to be friends with, a really lovely and caring friend that would come by to see if you're okay. I Can't have this much dedication but im working out to lose some pounds and next year i'll try to find a job. Or in 2026, too. I just wanna say that, well. Even tho i won't use this comment section as a diary, i don't want to just steal your place here. I Know how important this is to you, this vídeo and your entire journey. I Hope your journey ends with a happy ending, because as i said before you deserve it. I Really hope you become rich and becomes a manager of your own company. (I'd buy there everytime i could, and recommend it to my friends just because of how lovely you are.) Welp, i just wanted to come by here to say your history is inspiring. It inspired me too! Never stop having that much dedication in which you have, alright? You're already recognized in the entire world, and i feel like you can be much more. This history came to me because of a video too, but sadly i won't use that as a comment section haha! Welp, I Just wanna wish goodluck to you, and wish the best for you in rough times. And in good times too, i just wish the best, and by that i mean ''THE BEST'' for you. 

Welp, I Just wanted to pass by to say some things, because as you did, i too cried seeing your beautiful history. By now, i think it's a goodbye, till you reply to me or till i remember this exists. Lol!

Goodbye And Goodluck, Picsmics4.

Lowinns Out.

author: @picsmics4
text:
I hope everyone's well.  All of this blows my mind no less now than it did the first time people discovered this corner of YouTube.

I haven't been visiting any less often, it's just, I felt like it would be appropriate to let everyone's voice be.  I still read almost all of your kind, touching, amazing words.

Things have been challenging as of late.  I've lost my job about a month ago.  I am taking some time for myself to travel a bit and see family and friends that I have not seen in a long time, while I still have some savings left.   Come December, I'll start my job search in earnest.  

I've been planning to propose to my partner and get a place together, so this loss of income hit a bit harder than it would have, I think.  I'm uncertain what the future holds at this point.

But somehow, unlike the many times this happened before, I am not scared, discouraged, or even particularly sad.  I cannot describe in words how much your support have changed my outlook on things.  

Here's to hoping for the best for all of you.  Thank you, and thank you again.

text: Ouvindo esse vídeo em plena segunda feira, as 22:53, me traz uma lembrança muito forte de 2010 das noites dormindo no quarto com meu irmão, onde ele ligava a rádio num telefone antigo e colocava numa prateleira que ficava entre minha cama e a cama dele, e eu ficava ali escutando essas músicas pela rádio do telefone, me traz uma saudade enorme daquele tempo, hoje as vezes quando ouço alguma música assim com o áudio um pouco de “má qualidade” (comparada as músicas “HD” de hoje) paro e fico só ouvindo, e pensando no tempo bom que eu vivia, onde não tinha nenhuma preocupação, onde eu era apenas uma criança de 9 anos num quarto escuro, de janela aberta, ouvindo uma simples rádio num celular antigo, escrever isso me deu uma lembrança tão enorme que estou chorando muito. Hoje eu com meus 23 anos, quase acabado o ano, formado em engenharia civil, numa posição não tão ótima, mas não ruim, agradeço por tudo que tenho passado hoje, pelas lutas, pois sei que seja qual for a luta que estou passando, eu sei que sou forte o suficiente para enfrentá-la, e você que duvide muito que alguém esteja lento até aqui, fique firme companheiro, a vida realmente não é fácil, a vida é uma montanha russa, tem seus altos e baixos. ❤🥲

author: @-picsmics4
text:
For almost 17 years, I have been watching this same video. I am not a simple spectator; This video has become a part of my life. Every time I see it, I feel like there's something new, a little detail I hadn't noticed before. 

The video, with its unique style, has been with me in moments of loneliness and also in moments of happiness. It's like an old friend that I can always come back to. I have paid attention to the music, even to the silences. There is something in its simplicity that catches me and makes me think about the passage of time and what we feel.

 I remember the first time I saw him; I loved it immediately. Over time, I have projected my own experiences onto their images, finding comfort in their familiarity. Every time I see it, it is an opportunity to relive memories, to laugh, and sometimes even to cry. Sometimes I wonder if I will ever get tired of seeing him, but that idea doesn't seem real. 

This video is an anchor in a constantly changing world. In that cycle of seeing it, I have learned that repetition can bring me clarity and that in familiarity there is deep understanding. So here I am, in front of the screen, ready to get carried away again in that same story. Because in the end, it's not just a video; It is an important part of my life and who I am.

Thanks Everyone.

text: It was kinda of his personal journal, even it being a public video. Not something he was doing conscious or even revisiting the old notes. As he said himself, it was more about revisiting the video through the years for some kind of nostalgy, as it started as saving a video to learn drums and became into a venting place in the insomnia nights. Browsing youtube but eventually getting back to this same video and leaving a comment. He don't really wanted to make a buzz of it. He has been leaving comments for 15 years in a random vídeo with almost no engagement. My point is: I don't think that he has any intention, but this was a safe place to venting about life sometimes... He was not important. Now people will come every day to check if he commented something new to engage with him. It's no more the same place and, then, I don't think he's going to keep the same behavior. I think that all this exposition just destroyed his safe place :(

author: @coti8008
text:
Dia  08/09
Era um sábado que tinha tudo para ser tranquilo, o dia que eu esperava para descansar, desligar de tudo. Estava deitado no sofá, quando ouvi minha mãe gritando no portão. Corri para ver o que era e, com os olhos cheios de desespero, ela me pediu para não deixar meu pai entrar. Eles tinham brigado, e ela estava claramente abalada.

Antes que eu pudesse perguntar mais alguma coisa, ela entrou correndo para dentro de casa e trancou-se no quarto. O som da chave girando na fechadura ecoou pela casa, mas o que veio depois foi pior. Um barulho de vidros quebrando e o som abafado de comprimidos caindo no chão.

Meu coração disparou, não pensei em mais nada. Corri até o quarto e, sem hesitar, derrubei a porta. Lá estava ela, pálida, as mãos tremendo, rodeada por frascos de remédios espalhados pelo chão. Consegui impedi-la a tempo, mas tudo ao meu redor parecia um borrão.

Quando tudo acabou, fiquei lá, no chão, olhando para ela e para os comprimidos. Eu não sentia nada. Não sabia como reagir, como processar aquilo tudo. Era como se uma parte de mim tivesse desligado. Ela chorava, meu pai estava do lado de fora, e eu, no meio de tudo, vazio, sem saber o que sentir.

Era estranho, porque eu sabia que era grave, sabia que deveria estar triste, com raiva, confuso. Mas não sentia nada. Apenas um vazio enorme que me consumia, e não conseguia entender por quê, já aconteceu tantas situações CMG acho que no final eu talvez não seja uma boa pessoa.

Isso mostra como a humanidade ainda tem esperança de não desistir de seus sonhos. Uma pessoa muito determinada e bondosa.

Parabéns mano

author: @coti8008
text:
Dia 06/09

Hoje foi um daqueles dias intermináveis e cansativos, o tipo que te suga todas as energias. Acordei cedo, porque hoje era o dia da mudança para o novo escritório. Mal tomei café, já estava de pé organizando caixas, correndo atrás dos móveis, dos papéis, e tentando garantir que tudo chegasse em ordem no novo endereço. Parecia que nada dava certo. A equipe de mudança atrasou e, quando finalmente chegaram, esqueceram algumas das cadeiras ergonômicas que compramos. Tive que ligar várias vezes para a empresa, tentando resolver o problema enquanto gerenciava o caos ao meu redor.

Mas a cereja do bolo veio no final do dia. Quando finalmente terminei de organizar uma parte do escritório, o advogado com quem trabalho decidiu aparecer com alguns amigos. Eles estavam rindo e conversando sobre algum caso importante, e, claro, eu ainda estava com roupas suadas e cabelo todo desgrenhado por causa da correria.

Assim que ele me viu, apresentou-me rapidamente, mas percebi que ele estava constrangido. De repente, sua postura mudou, ficou mais formal, como se não quisesse que seus amigos me vissem naquele estado. Eles riram de algo, talvez da minha cara de exaustão, e eu me senti encolher. Era como se naquele momento, eu fosse apenas mais um detalhe embaraçoso no dia dele.

Depois de um silêncio constrangedor, eles saíram para almoçar e eu voltei a organizar o que faltava. Aquele pequeno incidente mexeu comigo, sabe? Já estava esgotado fisicamente, e esse sentimento de constrangimento só piorou o dia. Às vezes, parece que não importa o quanto você se esforce, sempre tem algo que te faz sentir... menor.

Boa noite.

author: @coti8008
text:
Dia 05/09 
Cheguei no escritório já exausto, depois de semanas intensas de trabalho como estagiário em um renomado escritório de advocacia. O ambiente sempre foi cheio de pressão, mas nos últimos dias algo parecia fora do comum. Os advogados mais experientes estavam tensos, e percebi que havia um murmúrio constante entre as salas.

No meio da tarde, meu chefe, um advogado veterano e influente, me chamou para uma conversa. Era raro ele me chamar diretamente, então já entrei apreensivo. Ele me entregou uma pasta e pediu que eu fizesse um “favor” rápido: precisava que eu revisasse alguns documentos e, em seguida, levasse um pacote para um cliente. Até aí, nada demais, mas ao olhar com mais atenção os papéis, percebi algo preocupante. A documentação envolvia bens de procedência duvidosa e mencionava um caso de receptação, algo que aprendi na faculdade ser completamente ilegal.

Me senti desconfortável na hora, e quando perguntei sobre o conteúdo, ele tentou minimizar. Disse que era "coisa pequena", que "não havia o que me preocupar" e que, como estagiário, meu papel era simplesmente seguir as instruções. O tom dele mudou quando percebeu minha hesitação, e ele insinuou que se eu não fizesse isso, talvez não tivesse "oportunidade de crescer" no escritório.

A pressão era enorme. Eu estava cansado e confuso, sem saber o que fazer. Sabia que, como estagiário, minha posição era frágil, mas também sabia que envolver-se em um crime como receptação poderia acabar com a minha carreira antes mesmo de começar.

No fim do expediente, fui falar com meu chefe, esperando receber o pagamento que estava esperando há dias. author: @Vsouza-u9e
text:
Assim como o Picsmics4 e outras pessoas encontram formas de viver mais e serem mais fortes para seguir em frente, eu também criei meu próprio mundo para sobreviver à realidade: a música, especialmente o rap. Quando ouço rap, me sinto mais forte; é como se eu encontrasse paz e alívio em sentimentos que não consigo explicar, mas que me fazem bem. Ele diminui minha ansiedade e, quando estou triste, o rap me ajuda a ser uma pessoa mais "durona". Enfim, eu enxergo o rap como parte da minha vida, refletindo tudo que passei e ainda passo.

Perdi meu único amigo de infância e, há quase 5 anos, perdi meus avós, que eram os únicos da minha família que me faziam sentir especial. Minha avó faleceu de câncer e, nove meses após a morte dela, meu avô também faleceu. Foi tudo muito rápido. Não tenho apoio de ninguém, não confio em ninguém; tenho pais narcisistas e cresci em uma cidade onde não fiz amigos, apenas pessoas falsas e influências negativas. O rap é meu melhor amigo.

text: Pics and I are not the same, we have different stories, different problems, but the feeling is the same of loneliness...

author: @Cebocoquito
text: Lately I've been getting a lot of messages saying that I'm imitating Picsmics... In fact, I'm Cebocoquito, a guy who identified with him a lot, because his life is similar to mine: Problems, responsibilities, loneliness, sadness and a little hope, when I saw him, I decided to vent to you too

author: @Cebocoquito
text: Now I'm 15 years old, life isn't taking me anywhere, I'm scared of the future, I want to talk because I don't have any friends, and I think I'll be venting here for a long time...

author: @Cebocoquito
text: My grandmother died a year before him in 2021, I was at a family party in a luxurious condominium and she was lying in bed... After a while, I decided to see how my grandmother was, but when I arrived I got there... She had a cardiac arrest in front of me... She was resuscitated and rushed to the hospital but didn't make it... I was 12 when she passed away and I was 13 when my grandfather died.

author: @Cebocoquito
text: August 30, 2024, I'm here watching a very old video that I don't even know why I'm venting here, I just know that I need to talk to someone because I've been very lonely lately, last year my grandfather died And he was a friend to me, I talked to him, listened to his stories, and I regret not having enjoyed it more... He had prostate cancer, he had to have a catheter and everything, but his surgery was Scheduled for December 2022, but in October he was hospitalized because he couldn't eat, and ended up catching pneumonia and died... Oh Manuel, I miss you so much.

🇺🇸: Hey guys, I'm from Brazil and I came to comment here, the story of picsmics4 arrived here in Brazil, I got to know it thanks to Minieto's channel, and after seeing the story I felt the need to comment here, I wanted to say that you are all amazing, I've always had a theory that even though news always appears on the internet about various evil things that people do, the world still has many more good people than bad, and this comment section is proof of that, seeing so many people helping a person they don't even know well, just out of good will and without expecting any reward, just their happiness is really cool. To give my support too, I wanted to wish much success not only in the life of picsmics4, but also in the life of everyone who is reading this comment, maybe even me in the future if I'm reading this, after all everyone who spent part of their life time just to read this deserves it :), unfortunately this is just a comment section, so the most we can do is send messages of support.  I'm only 13 years old so I don't know if my word will be that important but I hope it has at least helped someone, and when you think about giving up remember, 16 years, almost 17 years, and "He" never gave up, not on life, not on this video, not on this comment section that he uses as a diary. Thanks for reading this far, you guys are amazing ;)

🇧🇷: Fala aí pessoal, sou do Brasil e vim comentar aqui, a história do picsmics4 chegou aqui no Brasil, conheci ela graças ao canal do Minieto, e depois de ver a história me senti na necessidade de comentar aqui, queria falar que todos vocês são incríveis, sempre tive uma teoria de que mesmo sempre aperecendo noticias na internet de várias maldade que as pessoas fazem, o mundo ainda tem muito mais pessoas boas do que ruins, e essa sessão de comentários é a prova disso, ver tantas pessoas ajudando uma pessoa que eles nem conhecem direito, apenas pela boa vontade e sem esperar nenhuma recompensa, apenas a felicidade dele é realmente muito legal. A para dar o meu aponho também, queria desejar muito sucesso não só na vida de picsmics4, mais também na de todos que tiverem lendo esse comentário, talvez até eu do futuro caso tiver lendo isso, afinal todos que gastaram uma parte do tempo de suas vidas so pra ler isso merecem :), infelizmente isso é só uma sessão de comentários, então mensagens o máximo que podemos fazer são mandar mensagens de apoio. Eu só tenho 13 anos então não sei se a minha palavra vai ser tão importante assim mas espero que tenha pelo menos ajudado alguém, e quando pensar em desistir lembre-se, 16 anos, quase 17 anos, e "Ele" nunca desistiu, nem da vida, nem desse vídeo, nem dessa sessão de comentários que ele usa como diário. Obrigado por ler até aqui vocês são incríveis ;)

author: @pavansai_9
text:
I know there are doubts about this new account, and I want to share my truth with you. I lost access to my old account due to some unforeseen issues, so I created this new one. I’ve been commenting on this channel for the past 16 years because this song means so much to me.This song saved my life. During a particularly dark period of depression, I found solace and strength in its melody when everything else felt hopeless. It reached into my heart and offered a sliver of light and hope when I needed it most. Music has an extraordinary power to heal, and for me, this song was that lifeline.

I understand why there might be skepticism about a new account, but I assure you, I’m the same person who has been here, sharing my story and finding comfort in this community. I hope you can see the sincerity behind these words and understand that my journey with this song is real. Thank you to those who have supported me; your understanding means more than you know.
Thankyou for  supporting me to overcome my depression. And especially thank u for my friend @drazenxlive for this masterpiece. ❤❤❤

Guys, appreciate time, you cannot return it and money cannot buy it while you are young and you are 14-18 years old, do not give up anything, try to take the most out of life, this is the best time of your life, then it will be too late. With love from Russia. Stayin with u picsmics4

This song is good. It makes me feel like I know more about you knowing you’ve been here for years on end listening to this tune. 
I love you, friend i’ve never met, nor will ever. I love the Strokes also. I’m so glad you made it through everything.

author: @JosSalas
text:
recientemente vi un video sobre el caso de la persona comentando durante 16 años en este videos y ahora, me apareció en recomendados y obviamente tuve que verlo y darle like a unos cuantos comentarios de pics. 

pero mientras el video avanzaba pude sentir la nostalgia venir cuando escuché el solo, pics empezó a comentar desde hace 16 años atrás en este video y yo, hace 16 años visitaba sam’s club siempre que podía para poder jugarlo por una parte porque mi mamá trabaja ahí así que aprovechaba y otra porque no tenía una consola para jugarlo. han pasado tantas cosas desde aquel entonces, donde por este videojuego conocí las canciones de los strokes y nirvana, y siempre moría por jugarlo alguna vez en mi casa. 

en ese entonces tenía 9, ahora tengo 25 y muchas cosas han cambiado, ya no voy a sam’s club a jugar videojuegos soñando que en algún momento podré jugarlos en mi casa, porque ahora puedo, pude comprar mi primera consola con mi propio dinero y mi mamá ya no trabaja ahí, es un golpe de nostalgia que puedo entender en pics, espero que si alguien llegó hasta aquí les vaya muy bien en la vida, que si en este momento sienten que no les va tan bien, vale la pena lugar y aguantar, el tiempo termina ayudándonos.

author: @ZERO-yh9yh
text:
Hermano, siento que perdi el tiempo durante toda mi maldita vida, sin dejar una marca como la que dejo este sujeto, sinceramente es algo a lo cual siempre e querido relizar, sin embargo fue algo que deje pasar durante muchos años, mi vida a evolucionado negativamente, todo mejoro pero nuevamente y despues de muchos años mi vida nuevamente se fue al carajo, como me hibiera gustando poder viajar en el pasado y poder dejar una marca, no necesariamente con un comentario pero poder mostrar como mi vida a cambiado con el paso del tiempo, todos los problemas que e tenido, todas las personas q alguna vez considere muy importantes para mi y que actualmente ya ni siquiera me acuerdo de ellos, como pase de ser un niño feliz, a terminar en el hospital durante unos meses.
Como intente morir varias veces,
Como conoci a mi novia en internet hace aproximadamente 6 años.
Son simplemente historias muy interesantes que me hubiese querido contarselas al mundo, haber dejado algo en internet con eso.
No se si alguien lea esto si quiera, o acaso si es que entiendan a lo que quiero llegar.
Pero, solo me siento vacio por dentro, siento que desperdicie mi vida, la eche a perder, sali a delante, mejore, pero despues regrese al mismo lugar. Y nadie se entero de nada..
Nadie supo quien fui yo, nadie sabe todo lo que pase, nadie sabe como fui avanzando y reecallendo, nadie sabe como mi salud mental estuvo echo trizas, nadie sabe como mejore, nadie sabe todo lo que tuve que pasar para estar aqui, yo fácilmente pude haber dejado de exitir hace 3 o 4 años y nadie lo habria notado.
Es dificil de explicar todo esto con un simple comentario.
Como fue que me converti en aquella persona a la cual nunca quise ser de niño. Un tipo frio antisocial, al cual nadie sabe de su existencia, una persona a la cual desahoga su soledad estando en internet, pero al mismo tiempo sintiendose mal porque solo estoy perdiendo el tiempo.
Yo vi como el internet evoluciono, yo vi como las personas cambiaron.
Como algo tan simple como los memes del 2013 daban mucha gracia, los memes de la grasa, como la grasa murio y renacio en el 2017, para luego morir y volver en el 2019, para luego volver a morir y volver en la actualidad.
El como varias comunidades nacieron.
Pero bueno ese no es el punto al que quiero llegar, pero les digo, es dificil explicar todo esto en un simple comentario..
Ya no quiero seguir desperdiciando mi vida, ya no quiero seguir estancado en la misma mierda. Diablos, creo que e dicho eso tantas veces, que ya perdi la esperanza en que eso pueda cambiar, solo e desperdiciado los ultimos 4 años de mi vida y nadie sabe de ello.
Como en la acrualidad solo cuento con el apoyo de mi novia, pero.
Me pregunto que hubiera pasado si ella nunca hubiera regresado.
Me odio bastante, porque tuve que ser asi? Porque no solo hice amigos en el pasado? Porque carajo es que nunca puedo avanzar por mi propia cuenta?.
Donde mierda quedo aquel apoyo que me daba mi padre cuando yo era un niño.
Porque mi familia es tan cruel conmigo?. Porque todos me odian? Se que no soy tan carismatico pero, es necesario ser asi conmigo?
Cuantas veces no e trratado de salir adelante.
Cuantas veces e tratado de mejora, tener muchos amigos, porque quellas personas que conoci por internet solo terminaron dañandome.
JURO POR DIOS QUE SI NO FUERA POR MI NOVIA, YO SERIA UNA PERSONA TAN MISERABLE.
Realmente ya no tenia proposito cuando ella se fue.
Yo la amo, pero, y si un dia la vuelvo a perder?.
Ella es literalmente mi motivación para seguir dia con dia.
Yo no cuanto con apoyo mas que el de ella...
Porque las voces en mi cabeza de repente se van?
Que no se supone que istedes eran mis amigos?? Les preocupa que yo pueda salir adelante y finalmente deje de estar traumado?
Porque de repente enloquesi? Desde que momento empece a normalizar las voces en mi cabeza. Porque discuto con ellos, yo realmente tengo miedo, ya no quierl estar aqui, porque veo personas muertas. QUE FUE LO QUE HICE YO?! Yo solo quiero ser feliz, Que hice para merecer eso.
Solo extraño a mi abuelo.
Extraño poder convivir con alguie..
Cuando fue laa ultima vez que convivi con una persona?.
Simplemente me pregunto, porque nunca tuve amigos..
Era necesario todo el bullyng que recibi en la primaria, en la secundaria? DIABLOS PORQUE CREI QUE SERIA DIFERENTE EN LA PREPARATORIA!??? SOLO ME TOCARON COMPAÑEROS AUN MAS INMADUROS, PORQUE DIABLOS NADIE QUISO HABLAR CONMIGO, PORQUE TODOS SE INCOMODABAN CON SOLO MI PRESENCIA!??..
Porque?..
Yo tengo mucho miedo de que nunca logre tener un verdadero amigo.
Un grupo de amigos.
Al final de cuentas nadie puede llorar no?
Eso es lo que me hicieron saber todos a mi al rededor, solo termino viendome con una persona ridicula y patetica que solo quiere llamar la atencion..
Dios.. SOLO LLAMAR LA ATENCIÓN DICES!???
DIME, TU QUE HARIAS EN MI LUGAR!?? ACASO SABES TODO LO QUE E VIVIDO COMO PARA DECIRME ESO???!!!...
Nadie me conoce, nadie sabe quien soy, entonces porque la gente termina jusgandome!??.
Solo quiero salir adelante, solo quiero dejar de ser esta persona tan cobarde y estupida.
Solo espero y no siga siendo asi durante los proximo 5 años.. No otra vez.
Mientras todos le tienen miedo a la muerte, yo le temo a morir.. Sin haber vivido....
Gracias por tomarte la molestia de leer toda esta basura, igual dudo mucho que alguien la halla leido si quiera..

author: @niaschim
text:
@picsmics4 

I like to treat the entirety of youtube like my personal diary, and I like to hide super deep philosophical nonesense, or super shallow lolrandom nonesense throughout, whereas you seem to have picked one video through which to send an ultradeep taproot of genuine diary entries.

It's nice to know my polar opposite is equally weird but also seemingly not evil or anything?

Does that mean I'm the evil one?

Possibly, however, then again, the opposite of a good thing can be another good thing, since, good things can become bad in excess and bad things can be alright in moderation.

So to each their own, rock on man, just two ships passing in the night.

I probably won't get a response from you, but I hope you're well, and also genuinely who you seem to be in the comments and not someone doing a John Titor style immersive fiction.

I try to live my life like metafiction though tbh on so I'm not one to talk 🤣

It makes sense, when we're dead, we'll be nothing but a distant storied echo.

And when we sleep we're just an idea of who we are inside of an idea of a world with no physicality or reality from our dreaming perspectives.

And when we sleep, to those around us we're iust the potential of a person, we aren't doing anything and they have to invest in the idea that we'll wake up rested, if they wake us up early we not be the us they want since waking up early makes us cranky, even though we weren't even real in a full sense until we were awake which is weird.

And then the only time we are real is right now, when we are experiencing our reality.

So, yeah.

And not right now as in when someone reads this, I mean right now as in when I am writing this from my perspective, or we as in you when YOU are reading this, from your perspective.

The sociopathic idea that people fold up and stop like npc when they aren't in frame, the protagonist mindset, it doesn't go far enough.

None of us, exist in total sense, because anything in a total sense is infinity and infinity in a total sense is hypothetical, so nothing exists in absolute form, we and everything around us are just different ideas blending together in different levels of realness, realness is a gradient and ideas are a spectrum.

Rock on friends, strangers, future historians, and picsmics4, rock on homies, and love yourselves always, cos life is like highspeed rail, you get on, you look out the window, others happen to be there, and then you have to leave faster than you want to (the seats are soft).

So... rock on everybody here's to the eventual attainment of immortality, cos then humans won't be all sappy and they can just be eternal weebs living forever and watching the same youtube video an incalculable number of times if it makes them happy 🥰

Hello, picsmics4, I was reading about your story and it really moved me. To be honest, I am also going through something similar and it is difficult, very difficult...

Sometimes you wonder if you're really doing the right thing, what you're supposed to do, and it's not until after you do it that you start to overthink, I'm afraid of moving, I'm afraid of losing my job, I'm afraid of losing her, I'm afraid of failing, I'm afraid.

I hope, however, that this doesn't discourage anyone, I'm just taking revenge because I'm really a little lost in life, I don't even know if I should continue with my degree, I wouldn't be able to study anyway when I move, I don't know...

Anyway, this song (like picsmics4) motivates me and more than motivating me it makes me nostalgic, it's nice

Anyway, I'm going to continue enjoying my weekend a little more

author: @Devzunt
text:
Bueno para ser sincero 16 años es muy relativo, porqué? Nosé ahora mismo estoy diciendo lo primero que se me viene a la mente intentando relacionarlo con picmi, simplemente digo que cuantas personas más solitarias en el mundo habran comentando aunque sea un poquito de su vida en algún canal aleatorio de internet, supongo que deben ser muchas, pero como siempre la sección de comentarios ha sido infravalorada nose porque, ya que desde mi punto de vista pueden haber historias increíbles en los comentarios de YouTube pero siempre siempre ha sido un lugar medio olvidado y hablado superficialmente en la vida real, pero aún así sorprende porque literalmente existen millones de comentarios en YouTube y muchos de esos han de ser muy buenos, los comentarios de Facebook, Instagram, Twitter obviamente son mucho mas visibilisados en internet y hasta en la vida real, pero siempre me sorprendió el hecho de que los comentarios de YouTube hayan estado tan infravalorado durante casi 20 años simplemente no tiene sentido, Yo se que la gente tiene mejores cosas que hacer que leer un simplemente comentario, pero no me pueden negar que mas de una vez un comentario de YouTube los hizo reír...

author: @melsyoutube
text:
PICSMICS4 - i sincerely hope wherever you are, that you’re doing well. 

i COMPLETELY understand the process of documenting one’s life through media. i do the same with music videos. some things are like time capsules and bring a sense of comfort, sadness, nostalgia, melancholy, etc. 
the yearning for time lost and emotions once felt. rediscovering something for the first time in years, etc. i get it. 

i’m so glad the echoes of your sentiments have been ringing back to you with all the love you deserve!!! i hope your real life is peaceful and full of joy and financial security. i hope you’re not too busy to rest. and i hope you take comfort in knowing you have a sense of community here whenever you need a pick-me-up. 

please take care of yourself as best as you can! ❤️

author: @melsyoutube
text:
i don’t like how drazenxlive tried to imply this guy was “a troll” numerous times. he was always very respectful and encouraging and simply expressing his enjoyment! 

 he’s very clearly a kid that had to grow up  quick due to trauma and this is one of the few things that gave him a sense of escape.

text:

find that ive been socially reclusive for the past two weeks and it doesn’t help that i don’t have a job to give me a sense of routine. sleeping in all day and night when im not applying for jobs and getting rejected constantly. my thoughts get dark but i try to remain positive.

author: @JGuðmundsdóttir
text:
It's strange how you've been commenting on the same video for so long, and it makes you wonder why someone would keep coming back to the same place all this time. Maybe it's because you found comfort there, a place to express yourself when life changes.
Sometimes, we just need a small space to quietly share our sadness, and every comment could be a simple reminder that you're still here, even if no one replies.
I feel like you write not just to be remembered, but because you don't want to be forgotten. Your words touched my heart, and I felt something of myself in them.

I really hope you find the peace you're looking for, and that the days ahead are kinder to you. We're here, and you're not alone. I hope you're okay picsmics4, and I wish you all the best.

author: @B6mbproductions
text:
@picsmics4 sending love and support from Croatia.🇭🇷 Your story and occurrences are being spread through Europe and many, many more places. Just to think that I was barely even a kid yet while you were in high school and started commenting your experience ever since nearly the BEGINNING of this platform 
while trying to make life seem less complicated for so long wows me. I would have absolutely loved to be around at the time of your generation, especially here on YouTube. I've been watching it for so long and got so connected, it's practically my life. 

My younger self has been commenting on a lot of different videos that I loved, but never as long as you have let alone helping people get through life on the side of it. :D You are heard by many, even though we may not know you personally.. we are all going through and sharing something personal. When I was reading what you went through and some of the sensitive topics you were mentioning, it made me first of all so happy that there is someone out there who understands all of these unpredictable moments and situations that may happen when we least expect them.. 

but also made me realize I was reassured that none of us are indeed alone.. and how dedicated only one person can be to make a difference no matter what it takes causing an impact onto others. The memories that were made all the way back in our care free times were tiny symbols of what connects us in a way, and they are just proof that strangers on the internet are no different. I never played rock band myself.. I was also born around the times when Ps3 and Xbox 360 were released. One day soon enough, I am planning on trying it out on my Ps5 though, often enjoyed seeing play througs of other people on YouTube. I sincerely hope that this generation is still loving it as much as I am. Well man, take it easy.. :) you are never alone no matter how big the unforeseeable may get. w00t! forever

author: @SportLiveShorts
text:
Damn, something really interesting happened to me today, and it honestly shocked me.
I was at work, the weather was awful, and I was in a terrible mood. I decided to play some songs by The Strokes, including "Reptilia." I hadn’t listened to that band in a long time—probably a year or even two—because I just didn’t have the time. Work had completely consumed me.

But for some reason, today I remembered them, and as soon as I started listening, my mood completely changed. And that’s not even the most surprising part.

When I got home just now, I lay down and started scrolling through YouTube. Out of nowhere, I came across a video about the story of picsmics4. Imagine my surprise when I realized that his story was connected to the very song I had just listened to—a song I hadn’t thought about in years.

I don’t believe in coincidences anymore. I think something is always nudging us toward where we’re meant to be, so we can learn something or gain a new perspective.

Thank you so much, dear picsmics4. Your story gave me strength and energy not to give up and to keep moving forward, no matter what.

Wishing everyone the best of luck.

text: rock band has always been nostalgic for me: and seeing a video covering picsmics4 and this video and watching this unearthed so many emotions! my dad is obsessed with rock band, i remember playing for the first time at 6 years old on the beginner level… he would get my brother and i to play as a band often (me on vocals, brother on guitar, him on drums) and every now and then i hear i song i used to play on the various games and i feel like a tinge on warmth in my heart. i don’t really speak to my father anymore, but i miss these moments with him, i miss hearing the rock band intro come from the living room. grateful to see all the love in the comments that came from a small video over 15 years ago…
